description: Models that can play live matches in the recovered original engine (engine/), as used by the Arena website. Paths are relative to the repository root. Offline replay models (models/policy_bc_*, models/policy_v9, winner/realism/style models) are discovered automatically by the Lab website and are not listed here.

engine_models.name: Banana Hog 2
engine_models.summary: Overnight PPO continuation of Banana Hog 1 (13,632 games, 744 updates) on Hog 2.6 against the six-deck classic pool in the fast compiled league engine, with native placement masks and a greedy regression guard.
engine_models.result: Fresh-seed confirmation (144 games): 48.6% macro score vs 21.5% for Banana Hog 1 (+27.1 paired). Mirror 0.79, Log Bait 0.75, LavaLoon 0.54, Mortar 0.50, Golem 0.33, PEKKA Bridge Spam 0.00.

engine_models.name: Banana Hog 1
engine_models.summary: PPO fine-tune of Banana 1 on Hog 2.6 for two hours in the original engine, with tower-HP inputs and trainable placement.
engine_models.result: Sampled score against the original bots rose from 13.6% (parent) to 31.8% on the 44-game selection bank.

engine_models.name: Banana 1
engine_models.summary: Exact export of the policy-bc-v4.4.2 behaviour-cloning actor (learned from human replays), with no reinforcement learning. Plays any deck it has seen in replays.
engine_models.result: Reference opponent for every RL run.

engine_models.name: Banana Mortar 1
engine_models.summary: Three-hour PPO run on the Custom Mortar deck (first Banana league), without tower-HP inputs.
engine_models.result: 319 completed training games; no separate evaluation bank.

engine_models.name: Random bot
engine_models.summary: Plays a random affordable card on a random legal tile every few seconds. A sanity baseline, not a trained model.
